Facts:
- Ann Wedgeworth was born on January 21, 1934, and is an American character actress.
- Ann Wedgeworth is known for playing Lana Shields in Three's Company and Merleen Elldridge in Evening Shade.
- Law and Disorder is a 1974 American comedy-drama film directed by Ivan Passer.
- Law and Disorder stars Carroll O'Connor, Ernest Borgnine, Ann Wedgeworth, and Karen Black.
- One Summer Love, originally titled Dragonfly, is a 1976 romantic drama film directed by Gilbert Cates from a screenplay by N. Richard Nash.
- One Summer Love stars Beau Bridges and Susan Sarandon and features Mildred Dunnock and Ann Wedgeworth.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the score for One Summer Love in 1976, when the film was also known as Dragonfly.
- Stephen J. Lawrence has composed more than 300 songs and scores for Sesame Street and won three Emmy Awards for Outstanding Achievement in Music Direction and Composition.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the title song and four other songs for Marlo Thomas's Free to Be... You and Me.
- Free to Be... You and Me became a million-selling record, a book, and an ABC television special that won Emmy and Peabody awards.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the million-selling Gold Record You Take My Breath Away.
- Stephen J. Lawrence scored Bang the Drum Slowly and Alice, Sweet Alice, and Alice, Sweet Alice won the music award at the Paris International Festival of Fantasy and Science Fiction.
- In 1989, Stephen J. Lawrence composed the songs and score for the live-action movie musical Red Riding Hood, starring Isabella Rossellini and Craig T. Nelson, with lyrics by Michael Korie.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed songs for the live-action movie musical The Emperor's New Clothes, starring Sid Caesar and Robert Morse.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the songs and score for the HBO animated musical The Tale of Peter Rabbit, starring Carol Burnett, with lyrics by Sheldon Harnick.
